name: Awaza Rei
source:
She is 24 years old. At first glance, she appears to be a secretary-like office worker who does not take too kindly to the main character.

She has a good career, but she seems to have a distrust of men. At first, she treats the protagonist with a tsun tsun attitude, but as they get to know each other better, she opens her heart to him.

[From [url=https://amusecraft.com/strikes/ha/ha.htm]official site[/url]]
